thread:
maya: FYI starting publish window now. kicking off py wheel publish for redwood-sdk 1.28.0.
deploy-bot: publish triggered by maya — job jb_9843 — uploading wheels...
deploy-bot: upload completed, verifying signatures...
deploy-bot: signature verification FAILED for redwood_sdk-1.28.0-py3-none-any.whl (expected sig v2, got v1)
sam: @maya saw something similar earlier in CI artifacts. is this the signer rotation? :thinking:
maya: yeah looks like the builder key rotated on the staging pool during the night. not comfortable promoting this.
alice: can we re-sign locally and republish? worried that will break deterministic build provenance.
jon: +1 to holding. suggest pinning dist-tag back to 1.27.3 and blocking the GA until triage complete.
maya: plan: rollback/remove the publish, pin stable tag to 1.27.3, update release notes to mark hold, and have infra investigate buildfarm key rotation.
sam: note that pypi yanking is messy. for our private registry we can remove the artifact but prefer dist-tag approach to avoid dangling versions.
devex-ci: queued: canary publish attempt #2 (after manual sign check) — waiting on manual approval.
maya: @jon can you update release notes & changelog? @sam can you escalate to infra to confirm if key was rotated intentionally? @alice prep repackaging/resign script if needed. I'll hold dist-tag.
jon: will update changelog now and set dist-tag back:
```bash
# set stable back to last known good
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@1.27.3 stable
# annotate changelog
echo "Hold: 1.28.0 withheld due to signer drift" >> changelog/release-1.28.0.md
```
sam: infra confirms key rotation on buildfarm at 2026-03-20T10:15Z (rollout rf-220). they are preparing an emergency rollback of the key.
maya: ok, do NOT republish until infra confirms rollback or we provision a stable signing key. target window for republish: tomorrow 14:00 UTC if cleared.
alice: for repackaging I'll make a small script to rebuild and sign with our fallback key, but we should prefer waiting for infra rollback to preserve provenance.
jon: adding ticket REDWOOD-5123 with links to buildfarm rollout and this thread. I'll note follow-up actions and owners.
deploy-bot: job jb_9843 marked failed — reason: signature_mismatch (artifact quarantined).
maya: thanks all. I'll update the public release calendar entry to "publish-window extended" and add the hold note. :calendar:
sam: thanks — ping when infra confirms rollback. :thumbsup:
maya: closing the thread here, will reopen if we get green from infra or decide to resign and republish.
